title: Title
name: Name
enterDescription: Brief purpose, operating context, or notes for operators
addedRobotsNotice: Estimated allocation based on the target group units. Only active robots are deployed, so the actual count may differ. The last stage takes all remaining robots only when it is set to 100%.
rolloutStageHelp: Split the target group's robots into stages and deploy them in order. A stage moves on to the next only when it meets the minimum success rate, and the minimum observation time delays the next stage.
rolloutScheduleHelp: Reserve when the deployment starts. Currently the schedule is a screen input only and is not sent when saving or starting a deployment.
robotPickerUnavailableTooltip: A static group has a fixed robot list, so robots can be picked per stage. A dynamic group re-evaluates its condition at deployment time, so its robots cannot be picked in advance.
scheduleStageTooltip: The reserved time is when stage 1 starts. The following stages run in order based on each stage's minimum observation time.
unassignedRobotsTooltip: The stage allocations add up to less than the deployable units, so the remaining robots are not updated by this campaign.
deployableUnitsNotice: Only robots whose device management registration status is ACTIVE are deployed. REGISTERED / SUSPENDED / REVOKED robots and robots not synced yet are excluded.
unassignedRobotsNotice: {{count}} robots are not assigned to any stage. Set the last stage to 100% to cover every robot.
minSuccessRateNotice: The rollout proceeds to the next stage only when this stage's success rate reaches the threshold.
minObservationTimeNotice: Delay before the next stage starts. Use 0 or 1 hour or more. Not used for the last stage.
pauseAfterEachStageDesc: The rollout stops after every stage. An operator reviews the result and presses Resume to continue to the next stage.
scheduleStageNotice: When rollout stages are used, the schedule sets only the stage 1 start time.
excludedDeviceNotice: {{count}} robots were excluded because they are not active.
selectStageRobotsNotice: Click to pick the robots for this stage. Without a selection, robots are assigned automatically in order.
robotPickerUnavailableNotice: Robots can be picked only for static target groups. Dynamic groups are always assigned automatically.

stageValidation.noDevice: The selected target group has no robots to deploy.
stageValidation.percentRange: Stage {{stage}}: the target percentage must be between 0 and 100.
stageValidation.countRange: Stage {{stage}}: the target count must be an integer of 0 or more.
stageValidation.successRate: Stage {{stage}}: the minimum success rate must be between 0 and 100.
stageValidation.observationTime: Stage {{stage}}: the minimum observation time must be 0 or {{min}} hour(s) or more.
stageValidation.exceedTotal: Stage {{stage}}: the allocation exceeds the remaining {{remain}} robots.
stageValidation.emptyStage: Stage {{stage}}: no robots are allocated. Adjust the target value.
stageValidation.selectionCount: Stage {{stage}}: you selected {{selected}} robots but {{required}} are allocated.
stageValidation.selectionDuplicated: Stage {{stage}}: a robot is already assigned to another stage.
